name: Worg Warrior 2
body:
Worg Warrior 2
CR 2

Male worg warrior 2
CE Medium magical beast
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 44 (6d10+12)
Fort +9, Ref +7, Will +4

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.
Melee bite +8 (1d6+3 plus trip)

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 17, Con 15, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Atk +6; CMB +8; CMD +21 (+25 vs. trip)
Feats Iron WillB, Power Attack, Run, Skill Focus: Perception
Skills Bluff +4, Perception +10, Stealth +10, Survival +4
Languages Common, Goblin

ECOLOGY

Worgs are over-sized, evil, intelligent wolves often found dwelling amid goblins or other savage races. A typical worg has gray or black fur, stands 3 feet tall at the shoulder, and weighs 300 pounds.
